steps: Run the historical 450 ms pre-lease delay profile for five cold starts and determine whether the current 300 plus 500 ms completion budget still cancels it
Run a corrected 1000 ms pre-lease delay profile for five cold starts and require failed_preflight with ECANCELED, no mutation and no residual mount
Run a 1000 ms delay after the first mount for five cold starts and require verified rollback_complete with ECANCELED and no residual mount
Exit the mount worker after journaling the first mutation for five cold starts and require owner_death namespace taint plus complete namespace-member termination
Inject EIO into the verified rollback unmount after a 1000 ms post-mount delay for five cold starts and require rollback_failed namespace taint, never rollback_complete
Restore the production module, verify installed artifact hashes, run ten successful cold starts and receive one TXT plus one JPG through the two Android Providers
expected_result: Pre-mutation cancellation performs no namespace mutation, post-mutation cancellation rolls back verified mounts, owner death and rollback failure taint and terminate the namespace, and restoring the production artifact returns LocalSend and both Providers to normal operation
before_actual: The historical 450 ms pre-lease profile no longer exercised cancellation: five of five runs completed with all three mounts because the current preflight completion grace extends the bounded wait to 800 ms
after_actual: The corrected prelease1000 and mountdelay1000 profiles passed five of five as failed_preflight/ECANCELED with zero mounts and rollback_complete/ECANCELED with zero mounts respectively. Crash-after-mount passed five of five as namespace_tainted/owner_death/EOWNERDEAD with remaining zero. Rollbackfailure passed five of five as namespace_tainted/rollback_failed/EIO with identity-confirmed rollback failure, remaining zero and zero rollback_complete results. Production recovery matched every expected SHA-256, passed ten of ten cold starts, then received TXT and JPG with HTTP 200 and matching payload hashes without Provider crash
reviewer_conclusion: The current mount cancellation, verified rollback, owner-death containment, rollback-failure containment and production recovery paths have no unexpected regression on myron. Replacing the stale 450 ms test delay with 1000 ms is a planned test-profile correction. V-59 remains partial because fanotify is unsupported on this kernel and Provider restart, policy corruption, topology change and snapshot exhaustion were not injected on this device
